Folks — draft technical checklist and blockers for the Dec 27 activation. I recommend we keep the initial scope minimal: hosted sandbox with VPC peering to StellarHealth dev account. If they prefer Dedicated we can adapt but that adds lead time.

Technical steps (high level):
- Org setup: create org tenant for StellarHealth in our staging directory (owner: laura). Add SAML if enterprise — note this is optional for POC. Estimated: 1 business day.
- API keys: create one-time ephemeral API key flow for the POC (TTL 24h) + a service token for automated tests. Owner: priyom. Steps: generate, store in Secrets Manager, provide sample curl and SDK snippet.
- IP allowlist: ask StellarHealth for list of outbound IPs/CIDR. We'll provide an allowlist CSV sample (attached). For peering we need their VPC CIDR and peering contact. Owner: laura (coord).
- VPC peering prerequisites: both sides must accept peering; cross-account IAM role preferred for peering setup. Provide peering template (we'll attach). Blockers: overlapping CIDRs, missing peering contact, org policy for peering on their side.
- Security/compliance: fill out quick questionnaire; if they ask for SOC2 evidence, CS will provide sanitized logs and a SOC2 summary.

Attachments: network-allowlist.csv (stub) — contains column headers for ip_cidr, name, purpose.

Recommended deliverables and owners:
- Dec 18 EOD: StellarHealth returns CIDR + peering contact + procurement email
- Dec 20: Redwood shares MAP_DevicePeering_v1.xlsx + allowlist CSV + SOW stub
- Dec 21–23: Technical run-through: API key exchange, peering test, smoke tests

If we get CIDRs and contact by EOD Dec 18, Dec 27 is feasible. If peering is delayed past Dec 21 we recommend falling back to IP allowlist + mutual TLS for the POC.

- Prio
